 ‘Afterlife With Archie’ Disney+ Series Casts Its Archie, Veronica, Betty, Jughead & Sabrina
 By Rosy Cordero , Matt Grobar

 EXCLUSIVE: Roberto Aguirre-Sacasa has found the new Archie, Veronica, Betty, Jughead and Sabrina the Teenage Witch for his new Disney+ series Afterlife with Archie , based on his comic book series of the same name.

 Archie Andrews will be played by Vasco Faria ( Your Fault: London ), Aliyah Mastin ( Paradise ) will play Veronica Lodge, Betty Cooper will be played by Sarah Abbott ( The Body ), Angel Rivera ( Escape from Mr. Lemoncello’s Library ) will play Jughead Jones, and Sabrina Spellman will be played by Chloe Avakian ( Devil in Disguise: John Wayne Gacy ).
 From Warner Bros. Television and premiering next Halloween , Afterlife with Archie turns the all-American town of Riverdale into a zombie-overrun apocalypse — where the only thing scarier than the undead is trying to survive your teenage years. When a supernatural spell from a certain teen witch backfires, unleashing an army of the possessed dead upon Riverdale, Archie and his friends must fight to stay alive, testing the friendships, romances and loyalties that have always held them together.
 Watch on Deadline 
 RELATED: 2026 TV Cancellations Photo Gallery: Series Ending This Year & Beyond 
 Character descriptions can be found below.
 Archie is a teenager in the midst of an identity crisis, caught between who he was (a star athlete) and who he’s becoming (a reluctant leader), navigating shifting friendships (and possibly more) with Betty and Veronica. As the stakes around him become life-or-death, Archie faces a choice no son should ever have to make, with consequences that will haunt him forever.
 Veronica puts up a brave, fabulous front, but beneath her devil-may-care exterior is a reservoir of sadness that’s drawn her closer to the family she’s chosen, rather than to the one she was born into. As an unholy darkness overtakes Riverdale, Veronica feels more alone than ever, until something unexpected begins to stir in the shadows, beckoning to her.
 RELATED: 2026 TV Series Renewals Photo Gallery 
 Betty is a star swimmer who feels most at home in the water, where she finds solace and escape from a complicated home life. Raised to be self-reliant, she makes a fateful secret wish — one that seemingly comes true in a terrifying, unexpected way — that will test and transform her closest friendships and push her fraught family ever closer to the brink.
 Jughead pitches in however he can for his family, especially when it comes to looking out for his kid sister Jellybean. And though he’s best buds with Archie, he still feels like he’s on the outside of high school looking in. Until the unthinkable happens, and he sets off a chain of events that changes everything, including the order of the natural world — as well as Jughead’s own underdog status in it.
 Sabrina , to most of her neighbors, is the weird, homeschooled orphan girl who lives with her aunties at the edge of town. But we know better: Sabrina’s, in fact, a teenage half-witch, in a secret relationship with the delivery boy from Pop’s. But an even darker fate (and possible redemption?) awaits her.
 RELATED: KJ Apa Asked ‘Riverdale’ Showrunner Roberto Aguirre-Sacasa For ‘Afterlife with Archie’ Cameo: “I Don’t Know Who I’d Play” 
 The characters most recently portrayed were by KJ Apa (Archie), Camila Mendes (Veronica), 
Lili Reinhart (Betty), Cole Sprouse (Jughead) and Kiernan Shipka (Sabrina) in Aguirre-Sacasa’s comic book TV adaptations of The CW’s Riverdale and Netflix’s Chilling Adventures of Sabrina .
 Afterlife with Archie is executive produced by Aguirre-Sacasa and Jimmy Gibbons via Muckle Man Productions through its overall deal with WBTV; Greg Berlanti, Sarah Schechter, and Leigh London Redman via Berlanti Productions and its overall deal with WBTV; and Jon Goldwater for Archie Comics Studios. Alfonso Gomez-Rejon will direct and executive produce the first two episodes of the series.
 Faria starred in Amazon’s Your Fault: London and will next appear in Guy Ritchie’s Viva La Madness . Faria is repped by Waring McKenna and Myman Greenspan Fox.
 Mastin is best known for playing Presley Collins in the hit Hulu drama series Paradise , starring alongside Sterling K. Brown. Her credits also include the HBO series And Just Like That… ; the feature film Honey Girls ; and the Netflix documentary Stamped from the Beginning , where she portrayed renowned poet Phyllis Wheatley. Mastin is shooting the recently announced Sony feature film Narcs . She is represented by The Osbrink Agency, Calli Company Entertainment and The Carson Kolker Organization.
 Abbott can currently be seen in Netflix’s The Body , with additional TV credits including the Netflix limited series Poser , CBS’ Sheriff Country and Netflix’s Black Mirror. She also recently starred in Eli Roth’s feature horror film Ice Cream Man . Abbott is repped by TalentWorks and Ambition Talent.
 Rivera at a very early age played the lead role in Nickelodeon’s Escape From Mr. Lemoncello’s Library , with additional credits in Amazon Prime’s Countdown , Me Myself and I , and the holiday movie All is Merry and Bright . Rivera is repped by CESD Talent Agency, Thruline Entertainment and Del Shaw Moonves.
 Avakian next will be seen in the Netflix/21 Laps drama series and was recently in Peacock’s limited series Devil in Disguise: John Wayne Gacy . She recently wrapped a guest star in ABC’s High Potential as well as the feature Karate Ghost . Additional film credits include the IFC/Shudder feature, This Is Not a Test . Avakian is represented by Luber Roklin and The Characters Talent in Canada.
